name: PassportElementErrorTranslationFile
description: Represents an issue with one of the files that constitute the translation of a document. The error is considered resolved when the file changes.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of element of the user's Telegram Passport which has the issue, one of “passport”, “driver\_license”, “identity\_card”, “internal\_passport”, “utility\_bill”, “bank\_statement”, “rental\_agreement”, “passport\_registration”, “temporary\_registration”
